consumer: The mission/job completion check that asks 'is the courier job's objective satisfied so the player may hand it in?'
scope: The mission objective's own completion predicate over its required reach (the deliverable/target condition), not merely items on the avatar's person
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps raw wielded/worn/inv_const_slice item state, a re-derivable on-person inventory listing rather than the engine's computed mission-completion verdict
divergence: The required delivery item sits in a nearby vehicle cargo or a reachable ground tile (counted by the mission objective) but not on the avatar's person: carried_items shows it absent so the frontend stays dark, yet the engine's mission check reports the job complete
